How this estimate works

We start with the 2026 standard Part B premium of $202.90 per month, then add the monthly premiums you enter. We also show the Part B deductible ($283) and the Part A hospital deductible ($1,736 per benefit period). Higher-income enrollees pay more than the standard Part B premium, and this tool does not adjust for that. Check Medicare.gov for the amounts that apply to you.

Frequently asked questions

What does Original Medicare cost in 2026?
For 2026 the standard Part B premium is $202.90 per month and the Part B deductible is $283. The Part A inpatient hospital deductible is $1,736 per benefit period. Most people pay no Part A premium. Higher-income enrollees pay more for Part B and Part D.
Does Original Medicare have an out-of-pocket maximum?
No. After the Part B deductible, you generally pay 20% of the Medicare-approved amount for most outpatient services with no yearly cap. Medigap plans and Medicare Advantage plans handle this differently.
Are the plan premiums here real quotes?
No. You enter the premiums you have been quoted or expect to pay. Premiums vary by plan, carrier, age and location.
